Questions & answers

A few things you might
be wondering.

Here is how the process works, from the first conversation to the final plan.

Where do you work?

Our fictional studio is based in Bath and covers Somerset and the surrounding area. Consultation pricing includes travel within 20 miles of Bath; additional travel would be agreed in advance.

Do I need a large garden?

No. A courtyard, a narrow side garden or a single border can all benefit from a clear plan. We recommend the service that matches the scale of the changes you want to make.

How much does garden design cost?

Illustrative design fees start at £2,400 for a full garden, £650 for a planting plan and £195 for a 90-minute consultation. Construction, plants and specialist surveys are separate. A written quote would define the scope before work begins.

Can you work with what is already there?

Yes. We begin by identifying what is worth keeping: a mature tree, useful paving, a favourite plant or a view. Retaining good elements can give a new design character and help manage costs.

Do you build the garden too?

The studio provides design services. A landscaper would quote for and carry out the build. The final design helps you discuss scope and materials with them; any site visits during construction would be agreed separately.

How long does the design process take?

A full garden design typically takes four to eight weeks after the initial visit. Planting plans usually take two to four weeks. The schedule depends on complexity and how quickly feedback and site information are available.

When is the best time to start?

Planning can happen in any season. Starting several months before your intended build gives time for design decisions and contractor availability. Planting schedules depend on the plants and local conditions.

What should I prepare for a consultation?

A few photographs, approximate dimensions if you have them, your main questions and a comfortable budget range. It is also useful to think about how much time you want to spend maintaining the garden.

Does this website send real enquiries?

No. This is a portfolio demonstration. The form validates your entries and creates an enquiry summary you can download. Nothing is emailed, stored on a server or booked.

A good garden starts with a conversation.

Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll work out the next step together.
